sensors.name: light sensor LLIGHT (light from above, dim inside a tunnel)

actions.name: drive forward at 30 % (meant for the dark)

control_flow: driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT < 30 %, drive forward at 30 %; else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; else curve right.

likely_intent.description: Drive through the tunnel and come out the other side.

decision_points.condition: the light sensor LLIGHT reads below 30 %

branches.reason: The simulator's light never falls below 40 % (a tunnel's darkest), so 40 < 30 is never true and this branch is never taken.
branches.outcome: LLIGHT below 30 %: it drives forward at 30 % (meant for the dark)
LLIGHT 30 % or more: it calls stopAtWall

decision_points.condition: an obstacle is ahead in front (FRONT)

branches.outcome: an obstacle is ahead: it stops
no black: it curves right (left 40 %, right 10 %)

scenarios.coded_response: The light stays at 40 % or more, so it never drives straight: it keeps following the line (left on black, right otherwise), and where the line ends in the dark it curves right, circles, and stops when a tunnel wall is ahead.
scenarios.initial_condition: On a line that leads into a tunnel; bright light at first, dim light under the tunnel's roof, nothing in front of the robot in the dark.
scenarios.trigger: The robot drives into the dark part of the tunnel.
scenarios.title: Gets through the tunnel
assumptions: It reaches the tunnel by following a line into it.
'Get through' means reaching the far side of the tunnel.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It drives through the dark part of the tunnel and comes out the other side.
